**资料库无法覆盖完整“过去两年”**：现有报告窗口仅为 **2025年6月12日至9月29日**。以下比较只反映该窗口内可核实的目标价轨迹。

| UBS | 2025-07-08 | 买入 | **$175**；报告未披露前值或本次调整 | — | 12个月目标价为$175 [UBS Research, 2025-07-08, p.1] |
| 巴克莱 | 2025-09-25 | 增持 | **$200 → $240** | +$40 / +20% | AI算力部署和计划支出增强其长期收入信心 [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |

**差异很明显：**

- **巴克莱呈连续、阶梯式上调**：窗口内两次提高目标价，轨迹为 **$170 → $200 → $240**；从最初的$170到$240，累计增加$70，即约 **41.2%**。
- **UBS在资料库中只有一个时点**：2025年7月目标价为 **$175**，没有前值或后续报告，因此无法证明其在该窗口内有过调整。
- 横向看，7月UBS的$175低于巴克莱当时的$200；到9月，巴克莱进一步升至$240。换言之，**可覆盖资料显示巴克莱的目标价路径更积极、调整频率也更高；UBS则只能确认较保守的单点目标价，不能据此推断完整两年轨迹。**

| Barclays report date | Rating | Prior target | New target | Revision | Key signal |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 17 Jun 2025 | Overweight, unchanged | $170 | $200 | +18% | Supply-chain checks indicated second-half upside; Barclays also raised compute and quarterly revenue estimates. [Barclays, 2025-06-17, p.1] |
| 25 Sep 2025 | Overweight, unchanged | $200 | $240 | +20% | Barclays cited more than $2T of planned AI spending and greater confidence that Nvidia would capture much of the compute/networking opportunity. [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |

**Yes—within the available Barclays coverage from 17 June to 25 September 2025, it became more bullish on Nvidia.** The target rose from **$170 to $240**, a cumulative increase of about **41%**. The progression was first supported by improving Blackwell/supply-chain and revenue expectations, then by a stronger long-term AI-capacity thesis.

The nuance is that Barclays’ formal **Overweight rating did not change**, and its September FY2026/FY2027 EPS estimates shown on page 1 were unchanged; the later target increase therefore appears driven mainly by greater confidence in the long-duration opportunity rather than another near-term earnings revision. [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1]
